Resumo

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos : Cientista de Dados - Sênior

Atuar como referência técnica e analítica na estruturação, evolução e confiabilidade dos dados de Ad Intelligence, transformando grandes volumes de dados complexos em insights estratégicos que apoiem decisões de negócio, desenvolvimento de produto e melhoria contínua dos processos operacionais. O cargo combina excelência técnica em Data Science com forte entendimento de mídia, metodologia e negócio, atuando como elo entre Dados, Produto, Operações e áreas comerciais, garantindo que o dado seja consistente, confiável, relevante e acionável para o mercado.

  • Conduzir análises aprofundadas de dados para identificar padrões, tendências, anomalias, riscos metodológicos e oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos, processos e entregas.
  • Desenvolver e testar hipóteses de negócio por meio de abordagens quantitativas, apoiando decisões estratégicas e táticas.
  • Atuar como consultor interno para as áreas de Produto, Operações, Taxonomia, Comercial e Liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis.
  • Automatizar análises, relatórios e fluxos de dados, aumentando eficiência operacional, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar continuamente a qualidade, cobertura e consistência dos dados, identificando e investigando desvios, gaps e comportamentos atípicos.
  • Contribuir para a evolução do conhecimento analítico e metodológico da empresa, por meio de documentação, treinamentos, apresentações e troca ativa com outros times.
  • Participar de interações com clientes e fornecedores quando necessário, explicando metodologias, análises e implicações dos dados de forma clara e transparente.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências em mídia, digital, cross-media, Data Science e Analytics, propondo inovações aplicáveis ao contexto da Kantar.

Conhecimento Essencial

  • Forte experiência em análise de dados, modelagem estatística e Data Science.
  • Domínio de Python e / ou R e SQL.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e pipelines analíticos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e vice-versa.
  • Comunicação clara, didática e colaborativa.

Conhecimento Desejável

  • Conhecimento de ambientes de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento específico de mídia digital, cross-media, CTV, VOD.
  • Entendimento de mídia, publicidade e métricas de investimento (ou capacidade de aprender rapidamente).
  • Conhecimento de banco relacional e databricks.

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade :

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Gas Master Planning Specialist to join our Gas Operations Technical Support Division (GOTSD) under Gas Operations Technical Support & Planning Department (GOTS&PD)

GOTSD is responsible for the strategic growth and optimization of the gas business, integrating technical expertise, and digital and technologies innovation. ITMG also oversees the Master Gas Network planning, while optimizing the gas supply portfolio through advanced modeling and cost-benefit frameworks. It focuses on deploying cutting-edge technologies—such as AI, IoT, and digital twins to deliver high-impact solutions to shape the future of gas operations

Your Primary role is to help translating corporate strategies into comprehensive development plans, which typically span 10 to 20 years and are used to guide capital investment decisions.

Duties and Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Assess existing facilities and infrastructure performance.
  • Forecast future demand and supply scenarios, including shifts in market dynamics, population demographics, or regulatory changes.
  • Evaluate the impact of emerging technologies and sustainability practices.
  • Develop conceptual designs and scopes for new projects or upgrades.
  • Work on facilities planning which often leads Business Master Plans and supports Facility Master Plans.
  • Ensure that all relevant data and perspectives are integrated into the plan and aligned with priorities and resource allocation.
  • Perform cost-benefit analyses.
  • Compare alternative solutions to determine the most efficient and sustainable path forward.
  • Present data-driven recommendations to support decision-making at critical milestones.
  • Schedule regular updates (typically every 3–5 years depending on the plan type).
  • Revise plans in response to major changes in assumptions, such as new market conditions, regulatory shifts, or technological advancements.
  • Ensure the plans remain relevant and actionable over time.
  • As the successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical or Chemical. An advanced degree in Engineering, Business, or Project Management is a plus.
  • You will have minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the oil & gas industry or energy sector, with a strong understanding of upstream operations.
  • Certification in Project Management (PMP) is preferred.
  • You will have experience in developing or reviewing Master Plans for Gas industrial or infrastructure projects.
  • You will be familiar with capital planning processes, feasibility studies, and economic modeling.
  • You will have experience in working with multi-disciplinary teams and interfacing with senior management and executive stakeholders.
  • You must have a strategic thinking and long-term planning mindset as well as analytical and problem-solving skills
  • You will have project management capabilities, including scheduling, resource coordination, and milestone tracking.
  • You will have skills in planning and modeling tools (e.g., Excel, Primavera, SAP, or other enterprise planning systems)
  • You will be able to synthesize complex technical and commercial data into clear actionable plans is necessary.
  • You will be able to successfully endorse and implement capital projects based on Master Plan recommendations.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande , Espírito Empreendedor , Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre nós

O nosso propósito é transformar o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Começamos em 2001, como um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de pessoas talentosas que, por meio da nossa cultura de Sonho Grande, Mente Aberta e Espírito Empreendedor, tiveram a autonomia e liberdade que precisavam para transformar o mercado financeiro.

Porém, sabemos que o desafio é muito maior. Os grandes bancos ainda possuem 95% do mercado de investimentos no Brasil, mas estamos aqui para romper essa lógica e melhorar a vida de muito mais pessoas. Somos exatamente o que o sistema financeiro nunca foi.

Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

title: Managing Consultant, Customer Success
description:
Company Overview

Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure‑play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid‑to‑senior‑level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high‑quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision‑makers across large multinational organizations.
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.

Customer Implementations

  • Lead end‑to‑end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
  • Work with key stakeholders to map customer‑specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
  • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.

Renewal & Retention Management

  • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
  • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
  • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem‑solving.

Strategic Account Growth

  • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross‑sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
  • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
  • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.

Platform Mastery & Support

  • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, you will be expected to develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. This role requires you to deliver high‑level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. You’ll play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high‑quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.

Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
  • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
  • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.

Customer Reporting & Communication

  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight, platform metrics, and tailored recommendations.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot, ensuring accurate tracking of org structures, usage data, and renewal timelines.
  • Provide input to internal reporting (e.g., churn forecasting, customer health scores, and CS dashboards).

Experience & Qualifications

  • Fluent in English (additional languages is a huge plus, particularly Spanish)
  • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or a related discipline. A legal background is a strong advantage.
  • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal‑tech, or ESG space.
  • Demonstrated success managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving customer growth and renewals.
  • Proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, manage cross‑functional projects, and navigate senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Exposure to international accounts, with an understanding of NA/LATAM business contexts and cultural nuance.
  • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
  • Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned customer accounts.
  • Successful and on‑time delivery of all customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Clean, current data and insight‑driven QBRs shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support effective onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self‑service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end‑to‑end customer journey. Help refine internal operational processes to improve delivery consistency, reduce friction, and ensure high‑quality service across customer segments.

Designer UX/UI Sr (Product Designer) – Invillia Tecnologia – Home Office

Responsibilities

  • Análise de Dados: análise de indicadores de produto e negócio para identificação de dores e oportunidades.
  • Pensamento Sistêmico: capacidade de pensar de forma sistêmica, entendendo como as ferramentas de design impactam e interagem em um ecossistema maior.
  • Mapeamento de Jornadas e Processos: mapeamento de jornadas de produto e serviço, blueprint, identificando dores e necessidades que ao serem resolvidas melhoram processos de trabalho mais eficientes. Com ações mais propositivas.
  • Storytelling: Comunicação e apresentação do trabalho de forma organizada, estruturada e objetiva, engajando as partes interessadas e transmitindo o valor do design. Boa narrativa e oralidade.
  • Visual Design: Experiência consolidada no planejamento, concepção, criação e prototipagem de interfaces para diferentes plataformas. Experiência consolidada em mobile. Com um portfólio que demonstre atenção aos detalhes, hierarquia visual e domínio dos princípios de UI.
  • UX Design: Experiência na aplicação de princípios de design centrado no usuário, incluindo pesquisa, criação de personas, mapeamento de jornada do usuário e cenários/casos de uso. Melhores práticas heurísticas. Criatividade para explorar cenários inovadores e competitivos com o mercado.
  • Content Design: Habilidade na escrita de textos concisos e claros, alinhados com a estratégia de experiência da solução projetada. Acompanhamento do tom de voz para o público alvo.
  • Discovery: Capacidade de condução de pesquisas quantitativas, qualitativas e testes de usabilidade para explorar, validar e iterar as soluções propostas. Ciclos de validações rápidos e contínuos.
  • Ferramentas: Domínio de ferramentas de design, prototipagem, pesquisa e gestão de projetos, como Figma, Miro, Useberry, Maze, Clarity, Survey Monkey, Kanbanize, Jira e outras similares.
  • Pensamento Crítico: Facilidade para analisar problemas complexos de forma crítica e trabalhar proativamente em soluções para resolvê-los.
  • Atenção a Detalhes: Compromisso com a qualidade das entregas, assegurando que cada detalhe contribua para a evolução dos produtos.
  • Proatividade e Colaboração: Vontade e energia para buscar melhorias, colaborar ativamente e promover a cultura da organização e os princípios de design, contribuindo para um ambiente de equipe positivo. Pensamento design driven, data driven.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida como Product Designer/UX Designer, preferencialmente em produtos digitais complexos.
  • Vivência comprovada em produtos de crédito ou serviços financeiros, compreendendo constraints regulatórias, operacionais e de risco.
  • Domínio de UI, princípios de design visual, acessibilidade e responsividade, aliado à expertise em ferramentas (Figma, Design Systems) e capacidade de criar interfaces consistentes, escaláveis e centradas no usuário.
  • Domínio de UX Research, discovery, técnicas de validação e avaliação contínua de experiência.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de analytics (ex.: Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude) e capacidade de transformar dados em decisões estratégicas.
  • Habilidade em arquitetura da informação e criação de interações intuitivas e orientadas ao comportamento do usuário.
  • Capacidade de conectar insights do usuário, dados e visão de negócios, influenciando a estratégia do produto.
  • Perfil protagonista, que atua de forma autônoma, investigativa e orientada a impacto — identificando oportunidades antes mesmo de se tornarem problemas.

Are you looking to make your mark on a platform that touches the lives of millions of people? Then you’re at the right place. We designed a social dating experience where we bring people together. It's an amazing time to be joining the Inner Circle team as we continue to expand globally. And that's where you come in.

The #1 goal of your role is to surprise our members with a great experience that turn them into ambassadors. Listen to members, learn and translate that cross functionally so our team can focus on the improvements that matter most to members. Your speciality is providing the best level of service in written Portuguese and English. You know when to spot a bug, irregularity on the app and improvements based on customer feedback.

This is a flexible work from home position of 25 hrs per week. The days and hours can be planned around your family life.

NOTE: this role will also require working 3 hrs on Saturday and 3 hrs on Sunday.

Your impact

  1. Screening: Moderate registrations on Safety, Effort and Mindset so our users don't have to deal with fakes, scammers and spammers and instead can match with like‑minded, career‑driven singles – from all walks of life – who put the effort into dating.

  2. Support: Give members a truly surprising Inner Circle experience by listening and providing high quality personable support. From solving technical issues to giving profile advice in our helpdesk.

  3. Team focus: Be a team player that helps the teams focus on what matters most to members. Build a bridge to fill in the gap between customer experience, product development and marketing.

What will make you successful?

You naturally provide the highest level of service and keep the members best interest in mind.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English , with an appropriate blend of professionalism and friendliness.

  • You’re a true team player. Make sure to always proactively communicate about your work, keep the team’s best in the back of your mind. As well as communicating about bugs, ideas, improvements and other topics that might have an impact on the company.

  • You have a flexible mindset when it comes to working hours. Being able to jump in and help colleagues at busy times, work during the non‑conventional hours such as evenings and weekends.

  • Daring, authentic and ambitious

About Inner Circle

Inner Circle is a high‑quality dating app that focuses on getting you offline. To make sure your time is well spent, the team behind the app screens each member on safety, effort and mindset so you only see rich profiles from people you'd actually want to go on a date with. With a community of 3.5 million singles in 27 countries around the world, we help you match based on values and interests, making it easier to meet.

The independent bootstrapped tech company ranked in the FT list as one of the fastest‑growing companies in Europe. The company was also the winner of Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 in The Netherlands in 2018.

At Inner Circle, we embrace our diverse community and team. We celebrate differences and know that they are key for helping us grow. Whatever your race, religion, colour, gender, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or age, we make sure everyone has the space to be themselves.

Sounds like your perfect match! Apply today! And don't forget to send us a link to your LinkedIn profile.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.

The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
  • Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
  • Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
  • Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
  • Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
  • Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
  • Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.

  • Right to work in Brazil.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.
  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.
  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.
  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.
  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.
  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Analista de Dados Sênior | Governança de Segurança da Informação
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Somos a área de Governança de Segurança da Informação. Nosso time é responsável por estruturar, governar e transformar dados em indicadores e análises que apoiem a tomada de decisão em Segurança da Informação. Atuamos na definição e padronização de métricas estratégicas, táticas e operacionais, garantindo qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das informações.

Nosso principal desafio é fortalecer a cultura data driven, conectando áreas e equipes técnicas para desenvolver dashboards, análises e soluções analíticas que gerem insights relevantes. Trabalhamos de forma integrada com times de engenharia de dados para viabilizar estruturas escaláveis e sustentáveis.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido - Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Atuar como ponto focal na definição e gestão de KPI's e métricas corporativas, assegurando padronização e governança dos indicadores;
  • Levantar, analisar e priorizar demandas de dados e dashboards junto às áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções analíticas;
  • Estruturar, tratar e integrar dados de múltiplas fontes (Data Lakes, bancos de dados, sistemas internos e arquivos estruturados);
  • Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios em Power BI com foco em clareza, usabilidade e tomada de decisão;
  • Criar e manter documentação de indicadores, regras de negócio e dicionários de dados;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Big Data e Engenharia de Dados na definição de pipelines, modelagem e estruturação de informações;
  • Realizar análises críticas sobre demandas e métricas, evitando indicadores enviesados ou de vaidade;
  • Atuar como elo entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, garantindo comunicação clara e alinhamento de expectativas;
  • Propor melhorias contínuas em processos analíticos, qualidade de dados e modelos de acompanhamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de Produção, Matemática, Estatística, Administração com Ênfase em Dados, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Modelagem de Dados e Construção de Dashboards);
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL para consultas e análises;
  • Experiência com integração de dados de múltiplas fontes e ambientes de Data Lake/BigQuery;
  • Capacidade de estruturar indicadores, com análise crítica e foco em negócio;
  • Habilidade de comunicação para traduzir dados em insights claros para públicos técnicos e executivos;
  • Experiência em gestão de stakeholders e condução de demandas analíticas;
  • Organização, pensamento analítico e habilidade de storytelling com dados.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Python para análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de engenharia de dados;
  • Noções de automação de processos;
  • Experiência com versionamento (Git);
  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas de BI;
  • Conceitos de Data Governance e Data Quality.

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) serves as the operational and administrative anchor of the Office of the Dean and is the primary front-facing representative for the College of Arts & Sciences. Reporting to the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, this role is responsible for managing day-to-day administrative operations, front office services, facilities coordination, vendor and procurement activities, and student staff supervision to ensure a professional, efficientated Dean’s Office.

SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY:

    The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) works closely with the Dean, Chief of Staff, Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, associate deans, faculty, staff, students, visitors, vendors, and university service partners (e Procurement, IT).

    This role exercises independent judgment in managing administrative operations, resolving day-to-day issues, and coordinating resources to support executive leadership and college-wide operations.

    PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

    Front Office & Executive Operations

    • Serve as the primary front office presence for the Office of the Dean, ensuring a professional, welcoming, and well-managed environment
    • Manage front desk operations, visitor reception, and daily office readiness
    • Coordinate administrative logistics for meetings, events, and executive activities within the Dean’s Office
    • Maintain consistent front office protocols and service standards

    Administrative Operations & Workflow Management

    • Establish and maintain administrative procedures, workflows, and internal operating practices for the Office of the Dean
    • Manage document control, records management, and administrative filing systems
    • Draft, maintain, and update non-HR administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs)
    • Coordinate internal communications and administrative scheduling within the Dean’s Office

    Student & Administrative Support Oversight

    • Supervise work-study students and front desk staff, including scheduling, onboarding, task delegation, and time submission coordination
    • Ensure adequate front office coverage and operational continuity
    • Support administrative onboarding logistics for new staff (workspace readiness, access coordination, supplies), referring all HR-related actions to the HR Operations Coordinator

    Facilities & Building Operations

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for facilities, maintenance, and building operations for the Office of the Dean
    • Coordinate building safety, space readiness, and maintenance requests
    • Monitor office infrastructure needs and elevate issues as appropriate to Facilities Management

    Vendor, Procurement & Resource Management

    • Coordinate procurement of goods and services in accordance with university policies
    • Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, renewals, and pricing coordination
    • Track contracts, service timelines, and vendor deliverables (non-legal review)
    • Maintain inventory, office supplies, and resource allocation for the Dean’s Office
    • Oversee procurement card (P-Card) activity, including transaction processing, reconciliation, and compliance with university procurement policies

    Operational Partnership & Special Projects

    • Partner with the Chief of Staff on administrative initiatives, operational improvements, and special projects
    • Support the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration with administrative coordination and operational reporting as needed
    • Identify opportunities to improve front office efficiency, service delivery, and administrative consistency
    • Coordinates domestic and international travel arrangements for the Dean, as needed, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and adherence to university travel guidelines

    CORE COMPETENCIES:

    • Strong knowledge of administrative and office operations principles
    • Demonstrated ability to manage front office services in a complex academic environment
    • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
    • Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality
    • Strong vendor coordination and procurement management skills
    • Ability to supervise and develop student and administrative support staff
    • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and operate independently
    • Working knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including Workday.
    • Proficiency with office productivity tools (Word, Excel, Outlook) and administrative systems

    MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Passionate about infrastructure, interconnection, and the future of technology and software-as-a-service.

Digitally savvy and strong sales management background.

Excellent relationship building skills with demonstrated ability to build meaningful relationships with Equinix customers, prospects, and internal colleagues.

description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developer calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test, and deliver high-quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross-functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team members in development/test technologies, tools, and processes.
  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related field.
  • Expertise in software engineering.
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software.
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such as K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka).
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS.
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI frameworks.
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design.
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services.
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms, and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI).
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators).
  • Knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax.
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards).
  • Exposure to developing in agile and iterative software development processes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Requisitos e qualificações

title: Senior Project Manager Travel
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Events & Entertainment

Location: Brazil

Overview

The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament. This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event. The role requires turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, working under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders. Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers. The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones. By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight
    • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
    • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitivenes (RFP)
    • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
    • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines
  • Scenario Planning & Risk Management
    • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
    • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
    • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control
  • Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface
    • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
    • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
    • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments
  • Data, Systems & Process Governance
    • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
    • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
    • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems
  • Tournament Scale & Complexity Management
    • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
    • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

Your Profile

Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules are a must
  • At least 2 years of experience in project and event management

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in budgeting and accounting
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, additional languages beneficial
  • Practical commercial experience, distinguished geographical knowledge
  • Systemic and analytical thinking
  • Autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Practical and process-oriented working profile with quality and efficiency
  • Intercultural competencies, Flexibility, adapting working processes to different cultures
  • Strong team player
  • Clear communication skills in different languages
  • Friendly and diplomatic behaviour to customers, team members and working colleagues
  • Capability to promote knowledge transfer with other team members
  • Service-oriented working style
  • Taking initiative and working proactively
  • Speedy delivery of short-term orders, respecting deadlines
  • Vision to predict potential problematical scenarios and anticipate solutions
  • Creativity to solve unforeseen issues
  • Solution-oriented operation

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Strong GDS skills, with preference for Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules required

Acredita que não preenche todos os requisitos?

Um estudo recente do LinkedIn indicou que mulheres são menos propensas a se candidatarem a vagas se não acreditarem que preenchem 100% das qualificações. Em comparação, homens tendem a se inscrever mesmo atendendo 60%. Aqui na Cury, queremos construir um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais diversos e inclusivo. Você pode ser a pessoa certa e não queremos perder a chance de te conhecer.

Você curtiu? Estamos aguardando a sua candidatura!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gestão operacional, de empreendimentos e de processos

  • Coordenar os processos de Relacionamento com o Cliente, Backoffice, Comunicação e Gestão de Empreendimentos , atuando de forma integrada antes e após a entrega das unidades .
  • Realizar o acompanhamento assíduo dos empreendimentos , garantindo visibilidade do status de obra, vistorias, entregas, pendências e impactos na jornada do cliente.
  • Atuar diretamente na gestão e liberação de condomínio e IPTU , assegurando alinhamento com administradoras, órgãos competentes e áreas internas, bem como a correta comunicação aos clientes.
  • Gerir a equipe direta, terceiros e estruturas de apoio (G&A), garantindo organização da rotina, distribuição de demandas e eficiência operacional.
  • Garantir a execução, padronização, atualização e formalização dos processos da área, promovendo treinamentos e ajustes contínuos conforme a evolução do negócio.

Gestão de indicadores, performance e riscos

  • Validar, consolidar e reportar indicadores operacionais, gerenciais e estratégicos , incluindo temas relacionados a entregas, condomínio, IPTU e pós-entrega.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance (SLA, produtividade, qualidade, volumes, riscos operacionais e impactos reputacionais), elaborando análises críticas e planos de ação.
  • Atuar de forma preventiva na identificação de riscos que possam impactar a experiência do cliente, metas corporativas, imagem da companhia ou regularização dos empreendimentos.

Atuação estratégica e apoio à liderança

  • Apoiar a gestão na definição de estratégias, priorização de iniciativas e tomada de decisão , com base em dados, leitura de cenário e acompanhamento dos empreendimentos.
  • Atuar como braço estratégico da liderança , conectando operação, gestão de empreendimentos, indicadores e visão de longo prazo da área.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da jornada do cliente no pré e pós-entrega , propondo melhorias de processos, comunicação e governança.

Interface, governança e gestão de crises

  • Garantir alinhamento contínuo com áreas de interface (Engenharia, Jurídico, Financeiro, Marketing, Operações, Qualidade, entre outras), especialmente nos temas relacionados à entrega, condomínio e IPTU.
  • Assegurar uma relação estruturada com administradoras, órgãos externos e parceiros , garantindo cumprimento de prazos, acordos e obrigações.
  • Gerir o farol de monitoramento dos empreendimentos , acompanhando status, riscos, desvios e desdobramentos operacionais e estratégicos.
  • Responder pelo acompanhamento, intermediação e condução de casos críticos e situações de crise , com atuação estruturada, analítica e orientada à solução.

Qualidade, auditoria e fornecedores

  • Realizar reportes e acompanhamento junto à auditoria e áreas de qualidade, assegurando aderência aos processos que impactam certificações obrigatórias.
  • Responder pela atração, avaliação, qualificação e gestão de fornecedores relacionados aos processos de sua área, garantindo qualidade, eficiência e aderência às necessidades do negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência em Relacionamento com o Cliente, Pós-Obra, Gestão de Empreendimentos ou áreas correlatas , preferencialmente no setor imobiliário ou construção civil.

Vivência em pré e pós-entrega , condomínio, IPTU, interface com administradoras e órgãos externos.

Experiência em gestão de equipes, indicadores, SLAs e planos de ação. Conhecimento em governança de processos, auditoria, qualidade e gestão de riscos será considerado diferencial. Capacidade de atuar tanto no nível operacional quanto estratégico, apoiando a liderança na evolução da área.

description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware. Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

Responsibilities

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events

What we are looking for

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor\'s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

title: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the 'Control Room' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s 'Visualizations' and that the 'Data Pipelines' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar as rotinas de enfermagem da Instituição (passagem de plantão, registro de intercorrências, notificações de eventos, etc.);
  • Manter o posto de Enfermagem organizado para as atividades laborativas;

  • Realizar os registros seguros da sua prática profissional;
  • Realizar curativo simples e comunicar ao enfermeiro;
  • Preparar o paciente para exames e tratamentos internos e externos, se houver necessidade;
  • Observar, reconhecer e descrever sinais e sintomas, ao nível de sua qualificação, sempre comunicando ao Enfermeiro;
  • Executar tratamentos especificamente prescritos, ou de rotina, além de outras atividades de enfermagem;

  • Executar atividades de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais;

  • Apoiar na realização da contenção mecânica;
  • Realizar rondas conforme plano de cuidados;
  • Possuir escuta ativa e sensível;
  • Realizar manejo e abordagem aos pacientes com instabilidade psíquica;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente;
  • Zelar pela sua segurança, controle de pertences de riscos (giletes, fio dental, removedor esmalte, esmaltes etc.);
  • Auxiliar e incentivar a realização das atividades de vida diárias, tais como higiene pessoal, alimentação, mobilidade e eliminação;
  • Auxiliar no posicionamento dos pacientes confortavelmente na cama e movê-los com segurança quando necessário;
  • Realizar mudança de decúbito em paciente acamado;
  • Atuar sob supervisão do enfermeiro em intercorrências clínicas e psíquicas;
  • Auxiliar e incentivar na organização dos pertences e quarto dos pacientes;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e ordem dos materiais, de equipamentos e de dependências de unidades de saúde;
  • Oferecer apoio emocional aos pacientes, ouvindo suas preocupações e fornecendo conforto sempre que necessário. Buscando sempre um profissional da Equipe multidisciplinar e Enfermeiro em situações de saúde emocionalmente desafiadora;

  • Auxiliar o Enfermeiro na execução dos programas de Educação para a Saúde;

  • Participar de procedimentos pós morte;

Também integram o nosso portfólio itens como café solúvel, cappuccino pronto para beber, achocolatado, café com leite, refrescos, derivados de milho, filtros para café e porta-filtros.

Somos mais de 8 mil corações apaixonados pelo que fazem, e mpenhados em construir um país e um mundo melhores . Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho . Buscamos pessoas que querem arregaçar as mangas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Venha para 3corações e junte seu coração aos nossos!

description:
Analista de Comunicação Externa Sênior - L'Oréal Grande Público

Já se imaginou fazendo parte da maior empresa de beleza do mundo?

AL'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “criar a beleza que move o mundo”; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Na L’Oréal Grande Público, nossa missão édemocratizaro melhor da beleza, que significa levar a beleza para todos. E para nós, a beleza deve ser sustentável. A Divisão de Grande Público porta a marca número 1 de beleza no mundo com L'Oréal Paris, a marca número 1 de maquiagem com Maybelline New York, a marca natural número 1 com Garnier. A DPGP é a maior divisão do grupo L\'Oréal, com mais de 30mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo.

Missão:

Buscamos um profissional sênior com visão sistêmica para liderar a integração entre comunicação de marca e transformação social. O desafio central desta posição éconstruir uma agenda "Always On" de impacto social e sustentabilidade, com foco em comunicação, para as marcas da L’Oréal Grande Público (L’Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline NY, Niely e Colorama).

Este profissional vai liderar a estratégia que conecta os stakeholders internos e externos (ONGs, empresas parceiras, imprensa etc.) em torno de um propósito contínuo. O objetivo é garantir que o compromisso social da divisão e de marcas como L’Oréal Paris (programa StandUp) sejam um pilar perene de reputação e valor de marca, alavancando a reputação e o impacto das marcas com diferentes comunidades.

Principais Atividades:

  • Criar e gerir um calendário anual de impacto social que garanta visibilidade constante às causas da divisão, evitando hiatos de comunicação e mantendo o tema vivo para todos os stakeholders.
  • Liderar a gestão do programa StandUp em parceria com o Marketing Institucional e a ONG parceira, garantindo que a causa do combate ao assédio sexual seja um tema onipresente na narrativa de L’Oréal Paris.
  • Idealizar e operar iniciativas de sustentabilidade e impacto social dentro das ações de marca, assegurando que cada lançamento de produto ou evento tenha uma camada de propósito que reforce a reputação da divisão.
  • Atuar como o embaixador da divisão frente ao terceiro setor, estabelecendo parcerias de longo prazo que vão além do apoio financeiro, focando em cocreação e troca de expertises.
  • Mobilizar e engajar os times internos (stakeholders internos) para que a agenda social seja parte da cultura do negócio, transformando colaboradores em embaixadores das causas da divisão.
  • Manter relacionamento estratégico com jornalistas, influenciadores e formadores de opinião para garantir que as ações de impacto social tenham eco e relevância na opinião pública.
  • Apoiar o time de Comunicação e PR em ações de comunicação de marca, incluindo lançamentos e campanhas.
  • Traduzir dados e ações sociais em narrativas envolventes para imprensa e canais digitais, garantindo consistência e qualidade em todas as frentes de comunicação.
  • Analisar a performance das campanhas de comunicação e o progresso das metas sociais, sendo responsável pelos reportes de impacto.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência em Comunicação Corporativa, Brand PR ou áreas de Responsabilidade Social. Experiência prévia em comunicação e projetos de impacto social, é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de influenciar pares e lideranças internas para priorizar a agenda social no dia a dia da operação.
  • Entendimento de como o impacto social se traduz em valor de marca (brandequity) e lealdade do consumidor.
  • Perfil proativo para tirar grandes ideias do papel e gerenciar a operação detalhada de parcerias com ONGs e eventos.
  • Possibilidade de crescimento, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Você precisa ter pelo menos 18 (dezoito) anos para se inscrever. Para mais informações sobre como usamos seus dados pessoais, consulte nossa Política de Privacidade (acesseaqui). O uso do presente site é regido pelos nossos Termos de Uso (acesseaqui)

O Grupo 3corações é uma empresa de gente apaixonada pelo que faz. Crescemos pela força do nosso trabalho , valorizando nossas origens e nossa essência para irmos cada vez mais longe. Somos um povo inovador e empreendedor , que cuida dos colaboradores e proporciona experiências prazerosas para todos com quem nos relacionamos.

Nossa história começou em 1959, no interior do Rio Grande do Norte. Com nosso jeito de ser , inovador e empreendedor , nos tornamos líder nacional no segmento de café torrado e moído e cappuccino e vice-líder em café solúvel. Em 2013, lançamos a solução de máquinas multibebidas TRES®, com mais de 30 sabores de bebidas em cápsulas, e, em 2020, a partir da joint venture com a Positive Company, entramos para o mercado plant based, oferecendo aos nossos consumidores produtos 100% naturais, de origem vegetal. Também integramo o nosso portfólio itens como café solúvel, cappuccino pronto para beber, achocolatado, café com leite, refrescos, derivados de milho, filtros para café e porta-filtros.

Somos mais de 8 mil corações apaixonados pelo que fazem, e mpenhados em construir um país e um mundo melhores . Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho . Buscamos pessoas que querem arregaçar as mangas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Venha para 3corações e junte seu coração aos nossos!

Responsável pela execução das estratégias (Fotografia de Sucesso) definidas para o canal e região nas suas lojas de atuação, garantindo a exposição e organização de nossos produtos nos clientes, assim como estabelecer um bom relacionamento, identificar novas oportunidades e atendimento com todos os stakeholders da loja, de modo a maximizar os negócios junto de seus clientes.

Garantir que todos os produtos expostos na loja estejam precificados de acordo com a política de preços definida pela HEINEKEN BRASIL, sendo eles nos pontos primários ou secundários de vendas; Realizar a ativação de todas as campanhas solicitadas com material de merchandising, racks, montagem de Materiais Permanentes etc. Realizar pesquisas de avaliação na loja, a fim de promover melhorias ou reparar possíveis desacordos com a execução padrão da HEINEKEN BRASIL. Job Description

Job Overview:

Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

We are currently exploring potential candidates for an upcoming role at McDermott. If you are passionate about building energy’s future, and want to be considered when this role becomes available, we encourage you to submit your details.

Qualifications

  • Doctor Degree in Medicine and registration with the Regional Medical Council (CRM).
  • Certifications in advanced life support, such as Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) and Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS)
  • Advanced English CBSP and HUET NR 32 and NR 37

Preferred Qualifications and Education:

  • Desirable offshore experience

description:
A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.
Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais.

Descrição
  • Responsável pela gestão de todas as atividades correspondentes a execução da Operação e Manutenção no projeto de sua respectiva área de atuação, conforme escopos técnicos contratuais.
  • Gerir a execução das atividades e equipes correspondentes ao Planejamento, HSE e administrativo diretamente associadas a prestação dos serviços de O&M de aerogeradores.
  • Realizar a gestão direta das equipes dos projetos e de terceirizados.

  • Responsável pelos entregáveis da área de serviços aos Clientes, conforme os respectivos contratos de sua área de atuação, tais como: relatórios, planos e planejamento da manutenção, etc.
  • Responsável pela gestão e consolidação dos indicadores de performance da respectiva área de atuação, tais como: Disponibilidade, Relatório Mensal, Performance técnica - PR, desvios de segurança, planejamento e demais metas atribuídas aos projetos.
  • Responsável pelo cumprimento das diretrizes e procedimentos estabelecidos e aplicáveis as atividades associadas ao O&M em seus projetos.
  • Responsável pela gestão da frota, gestão de estoque e ativos da empresa.

Avaliar riscos de compliance (fraudes, subornos), como também, riscos corporativos (estratégicos, financeiros, comerciais) e propõem ações para mitigação dos mesmos.
