SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

Our teams also build the services which deliver Ubuntu to the world, on cloud, devices, servers and PCs.

description:
Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining EngineeringJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

VEM SER NATURAL DA TERRA!

Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa.
Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria.

Todos os dias acordamos com um único objetivo: promover uma vida mais natural – em todos os sentidos.
Se você também acredita nesse propósito, vem com a gente!

SUSHIMEIRO
Escala: 6x1
Tipo de contrato: CLT

MISSÃO DO CARGO:
Realizar a limpeza e conservação de peixes e frutos do mar preparando variadas refeições da cozinha oriental, conforme sortimento da empresa, verificando e garantindo a qualidade, frescor, aparência, exposição e organização da área de vendas para atendimento dos nossos clientes.

ATIVIDADES DO CARGO:
• Manipular e higienizar os produtos, observando a qualidade e a validade dos itens, a fim de garantir o aproveitamento máximo dos insumos evitando desperdícios sem comprometer a qualidade
• Preparar sushis e sashimis, além de outros tipos de refeições do cardápio oriental definido pela empresa, separando e selecionando o produto a ser utilizado, garantindo a qualidade e satisfação do cliente
• Realizar a higienização do local de armazenamento, garantir o correto acondicionamento das mercadorias e verificar a qualidade e validade dos itens em estoque
• Seguir as normas estabelecidas pela Vigilância Sanitária e Manual de Boas Práticas

REQUISITOS:
• Ensino fundamental completo
• Experiência Anterior

INCLUSÃO E DIVERSIDADE
Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.
Valorizamos a diversidade e estamos de braços abertos para todos os talentos, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual.

Alimentação no local

Plano de saúde

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil.

Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG).
Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas.
Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.

O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois!

Nossa Missão:
Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil.

Nossos Valores são:
• Jogo aberto e íntegro
• Foco em resultado com qualidade
• Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso
• Excelência no Atendimento
• Jeito simples e alegre de ser
• Atitude Responsável

Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família!

Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo.

Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda.

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

title: Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IHV Alliance Sales Director to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading IHV Alliances in the EMEA or APAC regions. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the IHV Alliance Sales Director will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in those geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. The IHV Alliance Sales Director will manage and grow a team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with IHVs, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of alliances including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution.

The Director is responsible for building trusted relationships with IHV partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelising the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and lead executive engagements.

Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or APAC regions.

As an IHV Alliance Sales Director you will:

  • Build strategic relationships with IHV partners at all levels
  • Grow their awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of large and complex organizations
  • Lead partnerships in APAC with companies like Lenovo, Huawei, Quanta, Fujitsu, Inspur, H3C, NEC, Asus etc.
  • Lead partnerships in EMEA with companies like Ericsson, Nokia, Bull, Siemens
  • Lead partnerships in the Americas with companies like Dell, HPE, IBM, Supermicro
  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management
  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Lead executive interlocks between IHV and Canonical leadership
  • Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person

Valued skills and experience

  • Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

100% Remote for Turkey, LATAM and India

title: Technical Solutions Architect
description:
Associate Solutions Architect – TestBox

Remote — Must be based in Rio de Janeiro or Niterói

$36,000 USD / year + equity & benefits

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

Role Overview

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities Project Ownership & Delivery
  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.
Customer Storytelling & Consulting
  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.
Environment Implementation
  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)
AI-Driven Efficiency
  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.
Documentation & Ticket Writing
  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.
Who You Are
  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.
Why Join TestBox
  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.
Benefits
  • Generous equity package for meaningful ownership
  • Prioritization of your professional growth, with dedicated career development support
  • Flexible, unlimited PTO with a minimum expectation for recharge
  • Mental Health benefits
  • Fitness allowances
  • Learning allowances
  • Remote and office setup allowances to ensure productive and comfortable working environments

ATRIBUIÇÕES

1.Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com a equipe pedagógica, com foco nos resultados garantindo a implementação da proposta pedagógica:

1.1 – Implementa, junto com a equipe pedagógica, o planejamento anual em conformidade com o projeto pedagógico do colégio.
1.2 – Participa, junto ao Serviço de Orientação Religiosa, do planejamento dos dias de formação e convivência.

1.3 – Colabora com informações relevantes no processo de avaliação de professores, em parceria com as CPS’s , a partir do acompanhamento realizado aos estudantes.
1.4 – Promove estudos que propiciem a qualificação e atuação dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
1.5 – Responsabiliza-se pelo processo de enturmação de estudantes.

1.6 – Mantém parceria constante com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento quanto ao processo de intervenção e acompanhamento dos estudantes junto aos professores.
1.7 – Elaborar em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento os processos de organização dos Conselhos de Classe.

1.8 – Conduz os Conselhos de Classe, orientando as discussões.

1.9 – Cumpre o Plano de Metas estabelecido a partir da Avaliação de Desempenho.

2 – Realizar gestão de processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento da aprendizagem dos estudantes considerando a excelência acadêmica:

2.1. Prioriza no plano operacional da unidade, as atividades específicas de sua função conforme a proposta pedagógica..
2.2. Estabelece foco na condução profissional das suas atividades.
2.3. Monitora o andamento da realização do plano de ação, visando à revisão de estratégias em tempo hábil.

2.4. Realiza análises quantitativas e qualitativas para respaldar as ações de intervenção junto aos alunos e às famílias.
2.5. Implementa ações que propiciem o processo de autorregulação de aprendizagem.
2.6. Orienta os professores para o acompanhamento do desempenho dos estudantes, especialmente aqueles com necessidades educativas especiais.

2.7.Efetiva projetos de formação de liderança e protagonismo juvenil em parceria com a coordenação do SOR.
2.8. Sistematiza processo de autoavaliação dos estudantes.
2.9 .Realiza projetos, junto aos estudantes, a partir de uma visão integradora dos segmentos.

2.10. Registra os processos sob sua responsabilidade.

2.11. Acompanha o desenvolvimento da aquisição das habilidades cognitivas dos estudantes, incentivando-os na construção dos hábitos de estudos.
2.12. Monitora criteriosamente o trabalho dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
2.13. Zela pelo cumprimento dos códigos de disciplina e ética dentro da escola.

3 – Promover a parceria Escola/Família na condução do processo educacional :

3.1 – Colabora com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento na realização de reuniões com os pais.
3.2 – Inova no atendimento às famílias buscando a fidelização dos estudantes.
3.3 – Estrutura com a equipe pedagógica uma linha de ação para a inclusão dos estudantes com necessidades educativas especiais e suas famílias.

3.4 – Colabora na acolhida e orientação dos estudantes novatos.
3.5 – Encaminha às famílias, por escrito, quaisquer medidas disciplinares adotadas pela unidade em relação ao estudante.

– Conhecimentos na área pedagógica adquiridos em pós graduação lato sensu.

title: Academic Dean, US Diploma Pathway
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally

Overview

The Dean is a cornerstone of Crimson Global Academy, driving student and staff success through strategic oversight of academic programs and meaningful stakeholder collaboration. Working collaboratively with the Deputy Principal, other deans, principals, and the Head of School, you will support the effective operation and continuous improvement of school programs while ensuring the vision and integrity of the US Diploma Program remains central as it continues to serve students globally. This Dean will support curriculum alignment, maintenance, and development aligned with CGA initiatives, while providing essential support to teachers and students across all learning modes.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Deputy Principal, providing direct support for group class instruction, student services, and day-to-day academic operations. The Dean helps ensure the Deputy Principal can focus on strategic initiatives and complex problem-solving by managing core responsibilities, including homeroom programs, student check-ins, faculty communication, and curriculum documentation.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with forward-thinking innovation – someone who understands the nuances of online education while possessing the vision to help shape CGA as an educational institution of the future. Your ability to communicate effectively across time zones, solve complex problems, maintain a global perspective, collaborate across departments, and execute with precision will be essential to your success.

Key Responsibilities 1. Student Success & Community Building
  • Support the Deputy Principal in ensuring comprehensive student services and engagement across all learning modes
  • Attend and support student processes and school-wide assemblies
  • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities
  • Support and mentor student leaders in their roles and initiatives, coordinating with the Deputy Principal on NHS and club activities
  • Attend and contribute to ceremonies that celebrate student achievements and student recognition programs
  • Support implementation of best practices in online high school community engagement
  • Proactively monitor student attendance and academic performance, implementing intervention strategies when necessary and escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal
  • Conduct regular student check‑ins to identify challenges and provide timely support, serving as a first point of contact before escalation
  • Lead student homeroom programs across all sections to ensure consistent quality
  • Support students across all three learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with student wellbeing programs and family communications
2. Faculty Development & Curriculum Support
  • Collaborate with the Deputy Principal, principals, other deans, and school leadership on policy development, implementation, and review
  • Support group class teachers in delivering high‑quality instruction across all courses, assisting the Deputy Principal with teacher observations and feedback
  • Lead curriculum alignment, maintenance, and creation initiatives to ensure consistency with CGA standards and educational goals, supporting the Deputy Principal's oversight of academic programs
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive curriculum review cycle to continuously enhance educational offerings
  • Create curriculum mapping documentation to ensure vertical and horizontal alignment across grade levels and subjects, supporting the Deputy Principal's curriculum oversight responsibilities
  • Establish and maintain curriculum standards that reflect both US diploma requirements and global best practices
  • Design and implement assessment strategies that align with curriculum objectives and measure student achievement effectively
  • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
  • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching, and maintain consistent staff communication
  • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes, supporting the Deputy Principal's staff development initiatives
  • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy
  • Provide day‑to‑day support for group class instructors, allowing the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic instructional leadership
3. Operational Excellence & Administrative Support
  • Partner with the Deputy Principal and leadership team on policy development, implementation, and periodic review
  • Support the Deputy Principal with calendar management and timetabling coordination, ensuring timely communication of important dates to all stakeholders
  • Assist with schedule changes and resolve minor conflicts, escalating complex issues to the Deputy Principal
  • Coordinate effectively across multiple time zones to support CGA's global student body
  • Support in maintaining organized student records and documentation in the student information system, ensuring data accuracy and clarity
  • Monitor and help approve students through the Enrollment Improvement Channel, working collaboratively with Admissions Officers and the Deputy Principal
  • Apply strong knowledge of the US diploma system and transfer credit policy to support student academic planning and course placement decisions
  • Review and evaluate transfer credits in accordance with school policy, escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal as needed
  • Assist with communications to students, parents, and staff regarding academic programs, policies, and diploma requirements
  • Support AP course coordination and College Board requirements as needed
  • Take on additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by Crimson Global Academy
  • Maintain and update staff and student‑facing documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance
  • Support coordination and consistency across CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses learning modes
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with admissions support activities, including academic planning discussions and information sessions
  • Help manage day‑to‑day operational tasks, enabling the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic problem‑solving and complex challenges
Qualifications
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in education, with demonstrated success in student and curriculum support
  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements, and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in education program development and execution
  • Experience supporting group class instruction and teacher development
  • Understanding of differentiated instruction and learning accommodations
  • Experience with student information systems and maintaining accurate academic records
  • Counseling experience or qualification (preferred)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong task prioritization abilities
  • Adaptable mindset with capacity to pivot quickly in response to changing needs
  • Self‑directed work style with ability to execute independently while maintaining alignment with institutional goals
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across leadership levels, particularly in supporting the Deputy Principal's strategic initiatives
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills to support operational efficiency
  • Passion for educational innovation and willingness to initiate self‑driven projects that advance the school's mission
About Crimson Global Academy

Crimson Global Academy is a premier online high school delivering world‑class education through innovative digital platforms. Our US Diploma Program provides students around the world with a rigorous academic experience that prepares them for success at top universities globally, offered through three distinct learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses.

Product & Project Management skills and experience are a plus.

Qualities
  • A dedication to keeping things simple and pragmatic .

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills: Proven ability to build strong relationships with technical and non-technical members of the team to solve challenging technical and business problems.

Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Chief Audit Officer
description:
Chief Audit Officer

Inside Higher Ed is seeking a Chief Audit Officer (CAO) who serves as the institution's senior audit executive, leading the internal audit function with authority and independence to provide objective assurance and advisory services across all university operations. The CAO plays a critical role in protecting institutional assets, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the achievement of strategic objectives through systematic evaluation and improvement of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes.

Benefits
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Planning & Audit Execution
  • Develop and annually update a comprehensive, risk-based internal audit plan aligned with the university's strategic priorities, emerging risks, and compliance requirements
  • Present the annual audit plan to the Audit Committee for review and approval, adapting priorities dynamically in response to changing institutional needs
  • Direct and oversee all internal audit engagements, including financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and investigative audits
  • Ensure audit work is performed in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards)
  • Implement and maintain a quality assurance and improvement program, including periodic external assessments
  • Coordinate audit activities with external auditors and regulatory agencies to maximize coverage and minimize redundancy
Reporting & Communication
  • Prepare and present comprehensive audit reports to the President, senior leadership, and Audit Committee, including findings, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations
  • Communicate significant risk exposures, control deficiencies, and governance concerns to the Audit Committee in a timely and transparent manner
  • Provide quarterly status reports on audit plan progress, emerging risks, follow-up on prior recommendations, and resource utilization
  • Meet privately with the Audit Committee without management present to discuss sensitive matters
  • Review audit workpapers, findings, and reports to ensure quality, accuracy, and appropriate support for conclusions
Risk Management & Advisory Services
  • Conduct ongoing enterprise risk assessments in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and prioritize audit areas
  • Monitor the institutional risk environment, including emerging risks related to technology, cybersecurity, research integrity, Title IX, athletics, sponsored programs, and student services
  • Provide advisory services and consultation on new systems, processes, policies, and strategic initiatives from a risk and control perspective
  • Track regulatory and legal developments affecting higher education, including federal and state requirements, accreditation standards, and grant compliance
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs on internal controls, fraud prevention, ethics, and risk management
Investigations & Special Projects
  • Lead or oversee investigations into allegations of fraud, financial irregularities, policy violations, or misconduct with appropriate confidentiality and due process
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, General Counsel, and law enforcement as appropriate during investigations
  • Conduct special projects and ad hoc reviews at the request of the Audit Committee, President, or senior leadership
Independence & Professional Standards
  • Maintain organizational independence and individual objectivity in all audit activities, free from interference in determining scope, performing work, and communicating results
  • Uphold the IIA Code of Ethics and maintain professional skepticism in all engagements
  • Ensure the internal audit function has unrestricted access to records, personnel, and physical properties relevant to audit activities
  • Avoid conflicts of interest and recuse from audits where independence may be compromised
Team Leadership & External Coordination
  • Recruit, supervise, mentor, and evaluate internal audit staff, fostering professional development and maintaining a high‑performing team
  • Promote continuing professional education and certification for audit staff
  • Manage the internal audit budget and allocate resources effectively to achieve audit plan objectives
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors for financial statement audits, federal compliance audits (Single Audit), and NCAA agreed‑upon procedures
  • Manage relationships with external firms engaged for specialized audits or consulting services
QualificationsEducation
  • Required: Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in accounting, business administration (MBA), public administration (MPA), or related discipline
Certifications
  • Required: At least one of the following professional certifications: Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Preferred: Multiple relevant certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise
Experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive internal audit experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role
  • Demonstrated experience in higher education, public sector, nonprofit, or similarly complex organizational environments strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of developing and executing risk‑based audit plans and managing audit engagements from planning through reporting
  • Experience presenting audit findings and recommendations to audit committees or boards of directors
Knowledge & Skills
  • Comprehensive understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and the COSO Internal Control Framework
  • Strong knowledge of governance, enterprise risk management, and compliance frameworks (e.g., COSO ERM, ISO 31000)
  • Familiarity with higher education regulations including Title IV financial aid, OMB Uniform Guidance, research compliance, NCAA rules, and FERPA
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and audit management software
  • Understanding of information technology controls, cybersecurity risks, and IT audit methodologies
  • Knowledge of fraud detection and prevention techniques
Competencies
  • Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire a professional team, influence organizational change, and navigate complex institutional environments
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Relationship Building: Diplomatic and collaborative approach, with ability to build trust and credibility across all organizational levels
  • Integrity: Unwavering commitment to ethical conduct, objectivity, and professional standards
  • Judgment: Sound decision‑making ability and professional skepticism, balanced with pragmatism and business acumen
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to manage changing priorities, emerging risks, and resource constraints in a dynamic environment

description:
Academic Dean, US Diploma Pathway

Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives? Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part‑time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high‑quality, personalised learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

Overview

The Dean is a cornerstone of Crimson Global Academy, driving student and staff success through strategic oversight of academic programmes and meaningful stakeholder collaboration. Working collaboratively with the Deputy Principal, other deans, principals, and the Head of School, you will support the effective operation and continuous improvement of school programmes while ensuring the vision and integrity of the US Diploma Programme remains central as it continues to serve students worldwide. This Dean will support curriculum alignment, maintenance and development aligned with CGA initiatives, while providing essential support to teachers and students across all learning modes.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Deputy Principal, providing direct support for group class instruction, student services and day‑to‑day academic operations. The Dean helps ensure the Deputy Principal can focus on strategic initiatives and complex problem‑solving by managing core responsibilities, including homeroom programmes, student check‑ins, faculty communication and curriculum documentation.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with forward‑thinking innovation – someone who understands the nuances of online education while possessing the vision to help shape CGA as an educational institution of the future. Your ability to communicate effectively across time zones, solve complex problems, maintain a global perspective, collaborate across departments and execute with precision will be essential to your success.

Key Responsibilities
  • Student Success & Community Building
    • Support the Deputy Principal in ensuring comprehensive student services and engagement across all learning modes
    • Attend and support student processes and school‑wide assemblies
    • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities
    • Support and mentor student leaders, coordinating with the Deputy Principal on NHS and club activities
    • Attend and contribute to ceremonies that celebrate student achievements and recognition programmes
    • Support implementation of best practices in online high‑school community engagement
    • Proactively monitor student attendance and academic performance, implementing intervention strategies when necessary and escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal
    • Conduct regular student check‑ins to identify challenges and provide timely support, serving as a first point of contact before escalation
    • Lead student homeroom programmes across all sections to ensure consistent quality
    • Support students across all three learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci and Flex Courses
    • Assist with student wellbeing programmes and family communications
  • Faculty Development & Curriculum Support
    • Collaborate with the Deputy Principal, principals, other deans and school leadership on policy development, implementation and review
    • Support group class teachers in delivering high‑quality instruction across all courses, assisting with teacher observations and feedback
    • Lead curriculum alignment, maintenance and creation initiatives to ensure consistency with CGA standards and educational goals
    • Develop and execute a comprehensive curriculum review cycle to continuously enhance educational offerings
    • Create curriculum‑mapping documentation for vertical and horizontal alignment across grade levels and subjects
    • Establish and maintain curriculum standards reflecting US diploma requirements and global best practices
    • Design and implement assessment strategies aligned with curriculum objectives and measuring student achievement effectively
    • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
    • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching and maintain consistent staff communication
    • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes
    • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy
  • Operational Excellence & Administrative Support
    • Partner with the Deputy Principal and leadership team on policy development, implementation and periodic review
    • Support the Deputy Principal with calendar management and timetabling coordination, ensuring timely communication of important dates
    • Assist with schedule changes and resolve minor conflicts, escalating complex issues to the Deputy Principal
    • Coordinate across multiple time zones to support CGA’s global student body
    • Maintain organised student records and documentation in the student information system, ensuring data accuracy and clarity
    • Monitor and help approve students through the Enrollment Improvement Channel, collaborating with Admissions Officers and the Deputy Principal
    • Apply knowledge of the US diploma system and transfer‑credit policy to support student academic planning and course‑placement decisions
    • Review and evaluate transfer credits in accordance with school policy, escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal as needed
    • Communicate with students, parents and staff regarding academic programmes, policies and diploma requirements
    • Support AP course coordination and College Board requirements as needed
    • Take on additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by Crimson Global Academy
    • Maintain and update staff and student‑facing documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance
    • Support coordination and consistency across CGA Group, Da Vinci and Flex Courses learning modes
    • Assist with admissions support activities, including academic planning discussions and information sessions
Qualifications
  • 3–5 years of professional experience in education, with demonstrated success in student and curriculum support
  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer‑credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in educational programme development and execution
  • Experience supporting group class instruction and teacher development
  • Understanding of differentiated instruction and learning accommodations
  • Experience with student information systems and maintaining accurate academic records
  • Counselling experience or qualification (preferred)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong task prioritisation abilities
  • Adaptable mindset with capacity to pivot quickly in response to changing needs
  • Self‑directed work style with ability to execute independently while maintaining alignment with institutional goals
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across leadership levels
  • Excellent organisational and time‑management skills to support operational efficiency
  • Passion for educational innovation and willingness to initiate self‑driven projects that advance the school’s mission
About Crimson Global Academy

Crimson Global Academy is a premier online high school delivering world‑class education through innovative digital platforms. Our US Diploma Programme provides students around the world with a rigorous academic experience that prepares them for success at top universities globally, offered through three distinct learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci and Flex Courses.

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement and implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign.

In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in‑depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur вялі Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high‑level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

Software Platform Engineering Manager – Ubuntu for Next‑Gen Silicon

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

With more than 1,200 colleagues in 75 countries, Canonical is a founder‑led, profitable, and constantly growing company that champions global distributed collaboration. What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Growing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. With more than 100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment. Our cross-border team is committed to redefining the energy sector by exploring new possibilities to achieve balanced, reliable, and affordable energy solutions. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same! Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. description:
Grupo FIT Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Você é um(a) líder que acelera com visão estratégica, paixão por gente e foco total em performance? No Grupo FIT, o(a) Diretor(a) é o nosso(a) piloto principal na pista, a liderança máxima da operação. É quem garante que as engrenagens rodem com excelência — da gastronomia à cultura, das vendas aos resultados. Com presença ativa nos boxes e olhar atento ao painel de controle, esse(a) profissional comanda múltiplas lojas e marcas, equilibrando agilidade, disciplina e visão de dono. Aqui, liderar é acelerar junto com o time, fazer pit stops estratégicos e manter o motor da operação rodando com alta performance. Se você quer estar no grid de largada de um time que valoriza gente, entrega e atitude, essa vaga é pra você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Diretor de Vendas no Grupo FIT, você terá uma atuação estratégica e multifacetada, garantindo a excelência em todas as pontas da nossa operação. Suas principais responsabilidades e atribuições incluem:

Visão Estratégica e Gestão do Negócio
  • Liderar operações com múltiplas marcas, formatos e perfis de loja.
  • Traduzir a estratégia do Grupo FIT em rotinas práticas e metas objetivas.
  • Apresentar resultados à diretoria com visão analítica, atitude consultiva e foco em escala.
  • Conduzir análises de DRE, planejamento financeiro e planos de expansão.
  • Testar e implementar novos formatos operacionais, com foco em crescimento sustentável.
Controle Financeiro e Resultados
  • Ser responsável direto por DRE, CMV, CMO, headcount e margem operacional das lojas.
  • Atuar sobre indicadores como produtividade, jornada, ticket médio e custo de mão de obra.
  • Liderar planos de recuperação de lojas com baixo desempenho.
  • Transformar KPIs em ações práticas de curto, médio e longo prazo.
Gestão de Pessoas Cultura
  • Liderar gerentes e líderes operacionais com protagonismo, escuta e foco em desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar feedbacks, avaliações de desempenho, planos de ação e sucessão.
  • Sustentar a cultura FIT na prática diária, sendo referência de atitude, disciplina e coerência.
  • Atuar junto ao time de Gente & Gestão em clima, engajamento e gestão de talentos.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de turnover, absenteísmo e clima, com planos preventivos.
Excelência Operacional
  • Estar presente nas unidades, conduzindo rituais de rotina, checklists e acompanhamentos.
  • Garantir padrões de limpeza, organização e segurança alimentar (conforme ANVISA e auditorias).
  • Criar e sustentar rotinas sólidas de abertura, acompanhamento e fechamento.
  • Controlar estoques, validade e perdas com foco em eficiência operacional e CMV saudável.
Gastronomia, Qualidade e Padrão
  • Atuar em conjunto com líderes de cozinha, nutricionistas e chefs.
  • Garantir padrão técnico e sensorial: sabor, montagem, tempo e temperatura.
  • Apoiar testes e lançamentos de cardápio com visão comercial e foco no cliente.
Vendas, Cliente e Marketing
  • Liderar times com foco em vendas, ticket médio e metas de atendimento.
  • Trabalhar junto ao marketing em campanhas e ativações locais.
  • Monitorar NPS, avaliações online e feedbacks de clientes — agindo com rapidez e inteligência.
  • Ser referência de postura no salão, especialmente em momentos de pico.
Relação com a Diretoria
  • Manter relacionamento direto com diretores e VP de Vendas, conciliando visões com foco em resultado.
  • Ser ponte entre o time operacional e a liderança corporativa.
  • Promover clareza, alinhamento e foco coletivo, sustentando a cultura de dono em todas as camadas.
Relacionamento com Concessionária (Aeroporto)
  • Manter relacionamento estratégico com a administração do aeroporto, garantindo conformidade com normas e excelência operacional no ambiente aeroportuário.
Análise e Planejamento
  • Analisar resultados, mapear processos e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação e projetos de otimização de resultados.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com a diretoria, promovendo alinhamento estratégico e decisões ágeis.
Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos um profissional com o seguinte perfil e qualificações:

  • Organizacionais: Disciplina que nos fortalece, Segurança em cada atitude, Gratidão que nos conecta, Vibração que inspira.
  • Habilidades: Gostar de estar em campo, liderar com presença e transformar desafios em ação. Entender que resultado é reflexo de ritmo, cultura e consistência operacional.
  • Comportamentais: Comunicação clara e inteligência emocional.
  • Conhecimentos: Domínio de indicadores financeiros, gestão de pessoas e execução estratégica.
  • Certificações/Cursos Desejáveis: Formação ou cursos em gestão de negócios, gastronomia, hospitalidade ou áreas correlatas são um diferencial.
  • Experiência Desejável: Trajetória sólida em operações de varejo, foodservice, hospitalidade ou franquias multiloja.

Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

title: Head of Market Analysis
description:
Descrição da empresa

Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma empresa norueguesa, com ações pautadas pela ética e transparência. É líder em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e a maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa. O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis - SC e também escritórios comerciais em São Paulo - SP (Vila Olímpia) e Rio de Janeiro - RJ (Leblon). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

Além disso, a empresa atua na comercialização de energia, a partir dos escritórios comerciais no Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP), com uma carteira de clientes comerciais e industriais de diversos segmentos.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Descrição do emprego

Como Head of Market Analysis, você será responsável por conduzir análises e previsões de preços de energia, bem como pesquisas de mercado, com o objetivo de orientar decisões estratégicas de comercialização de energia e representar a área e reportar análises para clientes internos e externos.

Trabalhando como Head of Market Analysis você irá:

Apoiar ativamente a rentabilidade da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento de análises e previsões de preços de energia, acompanhando variáveis como precipitação, vazão, demanda, intercâmbio de energia entre subsistemas, entre outros, com o objetivo de orientar decisões de compra e venda de energia.

Garantir que as informações inseridas nos modelos de análise de preços estejam corretas, por meio de análise técnica dos pressupostos utilizados nos modelos do CEPEL, consultando relatórios e dados publicados, e realizando processamento de dados quando necessário.

Analisar criticamente os resultados, identificando possíveis desvios e lacunas nos modelos.

Fornecer informações relevantes com qualidade e agilidade sobre fatores que possam afetar variações no preço de mercado, monitorando negociações, notas técnicas e processos da ANEEL e ONS sobre temas regulatórios, através de pesquisas e acesso aos sites institucionais.

Apoiar a melhoria dos resultados de ativos no Brasil por meio do desenvolvimento de análises e previsões de preços de energia, acompanhando variáveis como chuvas, afluências, demanda e intercâmbio de energia entre subsistemas.

Reportar rapidamente e com transparência mudanças regulatórias e informações de preço ao front office e middle office que possam impactar decisões de mercado e avaliações de risco.

Estruturar análises e cenários de preços de forma oportuna, de acordo com a dinâmica dos negócios da Statkraft, garantindo que os recursos e pessoas necessários estejam disponíveis.

Monitorar continuamente informações de mercado e práticas comerciais vigentes para priorizar e direcionar esforços de forma a apoiar soluções comerciais para a empresa.

Qualificações
  • Graduação em Engenharia, Meteorologia, Hidrologia ou Economia;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças/Projetos/Energia;
  • Sólida experiência na função;
  • Conhecimento nas seguintes áreas:
    • Formação e previsão de preços (PLD);
    • Análise meteorológica e hidrológica para o Brasil;
    • Operação e expansão do sistema elétrico brasileiro;
    • Regulação do setor elétrico brasileiro e Mercado de Energia no Brasil;
    • Análise probabilística e estatística;
    • Programação e automação (Python, VBA, Power BI e Shell Script);
    • Inglês avançado.
Informações Adicionais

Conosco, você desenvolverá uma trajetória profissional com oportunidades incríveis. Isso inclui:

  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional em vários níveis da organização, incluindo LinkedIn Learning, programas e ações de desenvolvimento;
  • A chance de fazer parte de uma organização verdadeiramente global, composta por profissionais competentes, inovadores e responsáveis, de diferentes países e culturas;
  • Uma cultura organizacional que cuida e respeita as pessoas, oferecendo soluções de trabalho flexíveis, princípios de equilíbrio entre vida profissional.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e seus dependentes.
  • Previdência privada, com contrapartida por parte da empresa.
  • Vale alimentação/refeição.
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos até 7 anos.
  • Auxílio para pais e mães com filhos com deficiência.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, respectivamente 6 meses e 20 dias.
  • PAS – Programa de Apoio Statkraft, serviço profissional com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, advogados e consultores financeiros.

O que é fazer parte da Statkraft?

É contribuir para um planeta mais verde e sustentável. Ser Statkraft é renovar a energia que impulsiona o mundo: uma energia limpa, inspiradora, com ética, integridade e segurança.

Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar pessoas a escrever a nossa história, com acolhimento e respeito à diversidade em toda a sua plenitude.

Ser parte da Statkraft é vivenciar os nossos valores, é ser competente, responsável e inovador. É ter uma comunicação aberta e transparente.

Compromisso com a diversidade

A visão da Statkraft é renovar a forma como o mundo é movido. Para navegar essa jornada complexa, precisamos de todas as vozes à mesa. Por isso, trabalhamos ativamente para ser um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo, e damos boas-vindas a todos os candidatos, independentemente de origem, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa, etnia, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Nosso processo seletivo é contínuo , o que significa que não há data limite para envio de candidaturas. Enquanto a vaga estiver publicada, seguimos avaliando novos perfis.

Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo através de nossa plataforma. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

The purpose of this position is to provide legal representation on behalf of the University in a variety of matters related to development, fundraising, taxation, and philanthropic activities.

Supervisory Accountability

N/A

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include a variety of University officials, the Vice President for Development and Alumni Relations, Academic Deans and Directors, the Chief Financial Officer, the Chief Administrative Officer, and other key stakeholders. External contacts include alumni, individual and corporate donors, and various contacts from educational organizations.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Offer advice and counsel on a wide range of matters and issues related to the endowment, restricted gifts, taxation, and real estate. Work closely on these matters with the Offices of Development & Alumni Relations, Real Estate and Finance.
  • Draft gift agreements, structure and negotiate capital, endowed, and planned gifts and gifts of non-marketable assets.
  • Counsel on pertinent tax issues and reporting obligations, administer testamentary gifts from trusts and estates, and advise on fundraising initiatives and the administration of the University's gift planning programs.

  • Prepare and supervise preparation of legal documents such as pleadings, dispositive motions, responses to charges and information requests, agreements, opinions and advisory memoranda.
  • Provide general counseling and advice on all issues relating to taxation as it pertains to any aspect of the University.
  • Independently represent the University in legal quasi-legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia courts and the federal courts having jurisdiction over District of Columbia matters. Also may represent the University in hearings, meetings, and other forums related to University legal matters.
  • Draft and negotiate, for subsequent approval by University officers, commitments involving University resources, principally settlements of claims, other agreements and statements of University policy. Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions.

  • Stay informed on new and emerging legal issues and regulations on all matters relating to taxation, gifts, donations, or other relevant issues that face a major educational institution.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.
